title: agents window
content:
# Use the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} The {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} runs agents in a dedicated {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} window. Use it to assign higher-level tasks, coordinate work across projects, monitor multiple sessions, and review outcomes in one place. Start with one task, then add independent tasks as needed. This guide shows how to choose where agents make changes, monitor sessions, and review each result. If you prefer to work beside your editor, you can [continue a supported session in the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %}](#continue-in-another-interface). Both interfaces let you direct agents and review their work.
Follow a hands-on tutorial to build an app with AI agents in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. * [Start agentic coding tutorial](/docs/agents/agents-tutorial.md)
